title: Concept: Neon Postgres connection URI in a response
description: A Postgres connection URI that points at a Neon host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URI carries the role, password and database, so a leak grants direct SQL access to the branch, bypassing every authorisation check the App enforces.
applicability: Deployments that render a Postgres connection URI that points at a Neon host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URI carries the role, password and database, so a leak grants direct SQL access to the branch, bypassing every authorisation check the App enforces.
